obligations.expected_behavior: Reconstruct the terminal semantic verdict from a fresh checkout using the pinned inputs.
forbidden_result: The same pinned inputs produce a different or unexplained terminal semantic verdict.
The reconstruction uses unpinned result-determining inputs.
obligations.observable_result: The fresh-checkout replay produces a terminal semantic verdict equal to the pinned-input reference verdict.
obligations.state_after: The terminal semantic verdict has been reproduced from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout and pinned inputs are available, but the terminal semantic verdict has not yet been reconstructed from them.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout semantic replay
obligations.trigger: An operator runs the replay from a fresh checkout with the pinned inputs.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reconstruct the Exact Cover result from a fresh checkout using the pinned inputs.
forbidden_result: The same pinned inputs produce a different, incomplete, or unexplained Exact Cover result.
Exact Cover is reported without being reconstructed from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.observable_result: The fresh-checkout replay produces an Exact Cover result equal to the pinned-input reference Exact Cover.
obligations.state_after: The Exact Cover result has been reproduced from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout and pinned inputs are available, but the Exact Cover result has not yet been reconstructed from them.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout Exact Cover replay
obligations.trigger: An operator runs the replay from a fresh checkout with the pinned inputs.
